title: queue backend
description: The marker .queue/backend: the backend every writer of a served folder takes turns with, so all of them stand in one line even when a lock service takes the turns (ADR-S14). Without it the backend is files. It never holds an address or a token; those come from each writer's own settings. apiVersion and kind never change, since two app versions read the marker at once; spec may grow (ADR-S15).

apiVersion.description: The form the marker is in, the same as the queue's tickets. It never changes, so two app versions sharing the folder both read it (ADR-S15).

kind.description: Always QueueBackend. It tells the marker apart from a ticket, which carries the same apiVersion.

type.description: files: the file queue in the folder; lock-service: a separate service takes the turns, for writers that share no disk (ADR-S14). An app refuses a type it does not run and never falls back to files, so no two writers of one folder take turns in different lines.

spec.description: What the marker says about the backend. Open: a newer app may add fields here, and an older reader accepts them (CT-RULE-4); never an address or a token.
